answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7305 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalaamualaykum Q)Because of this hadeeth will it be 1-makrooh e tanzeehi or 2- makrooh e tahreemi to fold trousers clothes etc and could you provide reference of the hadeeth.Jazakallah Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihe Wasslam said:" I was ordered that not to fold hair and cloth (In Namaz)" ted in Darr-e-Mukhtar with Shami Part one page 473. art one, Page 137) Question: Assalaamualaykum Q)Because of this hadeeth will it be 1-makrooh e tanzeehi or 2- makrooh e tahreemi to fold trousers clothes etc and could you provide reference of the hadeeth.Jazakallah Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihe Wasslam said:" I was ordered that not to fold hair and cloth (In Namaz)" ted in Darr-e-Mukhtar with Shami Part one page 473. art one, Page 137) Answer ID: 7305 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1240/1146=L/1429) It is makrooh-e-tahrimi to fold and play with clothes etc during salah : وکرہ لفہ ای رفعہ ? و عبثہ بثوبہ، وفی الشامی: وھی کراھۃ تحریم کما فی البحر ( در مختار مع شامی 2:406 ) The abovementioned Hadith has been narrated by Bukhari: عن ابن عباس عن النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم قال: امرنا ان نسجد علی سبعۃ اعظم و لا نکف شعراً و لا ثوباً (صحیح البخاری 1:112، باب السجود لعی سبعۃ اعظم، رقم الحدیث: 809-811) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
